, Reason for Mistake: The Planner gave role-inappropriate instructions by asking the WebSurfer to create a Planner-style message instead of conducting the requested searches and verifications. This caused role confusion and repetitive, incomplete evidence gathering. Although the factual conclusion (that both are not in Michigan) remained correct, this was the earliest clear procedural mistake.
